entries.note: Overlap count 1,805 differs from observable_state QUALIFICATION_L1000 (1,845): this run filters L1000 signatures to PRISM-matched lines first.
JUMP edge not assessed beyond directory presence: data/external/jump_target is empty.
Protocol numbers were proposed gates; the practical threshold 0.010 and the primary contrasts were fixed in FREEZE_PROTOCOL.md after search and select and before the test folds.
The first verify.py was structural only; it was replaced by the verifier that recomputes DECISION.json.

The first search run used hierarchical-cluster slices of unequal size (some policies measured up to 90% of the pool, i.e. unequal cost). It is kept in discarded_run0/; slices were changed to equal-size dendrogram blocks and search was rerun. Atlas values were unchanged.

far_run.py, far_analyse.py and far_vault.py were edited during development (primary repair, extra policies) and are not in the FREEZE.json hashes; far_core.py, far_data.py, MODEL.json, VALUE_MODEL.pkl and FREEZE_PROTOCOL.md are. Select, test and vault used the same primary repair and policies.
FAR-v2 (expected-benefit model) was added after the signature model gave a null in search; both were taken to select and test and reported. Holm over C1/C2 was not needed because neither passed.
The vault stage rebuilds the arena by editing far_data.py source text in memory (include sealed names, vault fold 9). The vault is a reuse of block-N drugs, not independent confirmation.
The residual expert is a ridge from 30 L1000 principal components to the fold-wise leave-out base residual of the references; no Tanimoto purge was applied between reference folds in that inner step.

No pytest or repository shape test was run for this study under the original brief; after the full-permission grant the study was verified with verify.py (frozen hashes, DECISION recompute, one contrast recompute).
